items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Yeah, he played two horns. He played sax, he played anything. Piano, he gave a lesson.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played two horns. He played sax, he played anything. Piano, he gave a lesson. Oh yeah, he used to, he used to do that. We used to call him horse. Yeah. He used to stomp so much.
